THE LEARNING PATH

Where do we start? What comes next?

Thirty-eight classes are ready now, from birth to age five, in one calm sequence. Each class takes two to five playful minutes and is led by you. Age ranges are a guide, not a test — start where your child is and follow their cues.

BonusExtra classes

Extra Classes — a bonus shelf beside the path

Play: The Toddler Room (ages 1–3) · Kitchen Helper (ages 3–6) · Doctor Visit (ages 3–5) · Home and Daily Life (ages 3–5) · Kids Games (ages 3–5) · Places in the Community (ages 3–5) · Animal Categories (ages 3–5) · Colors (ages 2–5) · Look & Learn (ages 2–5) · Nature Club (ages 3–6)

Every one of them carries its own flashcards and its own lessons, and every one of them is optional — the core path never depends on them. Browse the whole shelf at Extra Classes, or step next door to the Nature Club.

+
Growing upAges 3–12

Classrooms for older children

Beyond the early years, the school opens into hands-on classrooms: Art Studio, Science Lab, Nature Club, Maths Room, Story Corner and Build & Tinker, plus the Clubs — forty-five after-school activities from art to coding — and all activities by age.

+
PreschoolAge 3 magic games

The magic games — a separate shelf for playful practice

Play: Look & Draw — Magic Shapes (Class 3) · Animal Sound Safari (Class 6)

Two gentle interactive games with no scores and no timers — each one is wired to its Age 3 class and lives on its own shelf, outside the class sequence.

Age ranges are a guide, not a test. Children learn at their own pace. Explore in any order that suits your family, and stop whenever your child has had enough.

EVERY CLASS COUNTS

Little celebrations along the way.

A finished class is a real thing: a game played to its celebration, a worksheet on the fridge, a book read twice. The path is long and growing — every small step on it deserves its moment.
